sources.summary: This update brings more control over default models and MCP server in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains. It also makes diagnostics easier to address, improves chat navigation and account controls, and… The post New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 此更新針對 JetBrains 版的 GitHub Copilot 帶來了更多對預設模型與 MCP 伺服器的掌控能力。它也讓診斷問題變得更簡單、改善了對話導覽與帳號控制，並且……這篇文章〈New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains〉最初發表於 The GitHub Blog。
